### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **28** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/api.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`, `packages/spec/declaration-map/api.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**22** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b8456ebd4abb498233a13bdd65955d14e7e46825`.

⛔ **12** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/api.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`, `packages/spec/declaration-map/api.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **177** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b8456ebd4abb498233a13bdd65955d14e7e46825` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `925696b487bc88fa64c907434d02591c1c5a60a1` — the merge of head `624b7ff3930c868fa9e904cbdb818182361edcc4` into base `b8456ebd4abb498233a13bdd65955d14e7e46825`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 925696b487bc88fa64c907434d02591c1c5a60a1 && git checkout 925696b487bc88fa64c907434d02591c1c5a60a1
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin b8456ebd4abb498233a13bdd65955d14e7e46825 624b7ff3930c868fa9e904cbdb818182361edcc4 && git checkout -B drift-repro b8456ebd4abb498233a13bdd65955d14e7e46825 && git merge --no-ff 624b7ff3930c868fa9e904cbdb818182361edcc4

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b8456ebd4abb498233a13bdd65955d14e7e46825
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs b8456ebd4abb498233a13bdd65955d14e7e46825` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts, packages/spec/api-surface/api.json, packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json, packages/spec/declaration-map/api.json, packages/spec/export-origins/api.json, packages/spec/json-schema.manifest/api.json, docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.counts/api.md, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-diff-delete-load.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-diff-history-slots.33308.test.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts, packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-package-selector.test.ts, packages/rest/src/rest-server-meta-door-closed-sets.test.ts, packages/qa/dogfood/test/history-diff-two-holders-33308.dogfood.test.ts, .changeset/33308-diff-door-package-address.md, content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx, content/docs/references/index.mdx + packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-slots.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-commits.ts, packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts, packages/rest/src/error-response.ts, packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts, packages/client/src/index.ts, ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts (read, not reviewed)

Read at 2026-11-15T23:10Z. First review of this head, taken on patrol as owed; claim: comment 6902844568. Independence: implemented in a zhuangjianguo lane (domain:server#5); neither dispatched nor implemented by os-tesla.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The rule is the family's, taken by call and not by copy.** `diffMetaItem` asks `historySlotOf` (unchanged file) with the same arguments the history and rollback doors pass, and narrows only when the request named a package (`slot?.addressed`), exactly as `historyMetaItem` (`versionsOf`) and `rollbackMetaItem` (`versionOf`) do. So the bare refusal is the same object the other two doors throw: `PackageScopedNameRefusedError`, `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, reason `ambiguous-in-environment`, `callerPackageId: null`, candidates the bound packages in `packagelessAddress` order and then the environment holder. It is thrown before any history or active row is read (the facet pin asserts an empty read list).
- **Parity with the plain and layered reads.** Where the bare plain read refuses a name (two packages hold it in code, ADR-0150 D5), the diff door rethrows that read's own refusal from the registry resolver, so code, status and candidates are that read's by identity; the dogfood case compares the two answers on one boot. Against PR #33885's layered-read refusal (read at `e57e7c05`): same order of the two judgments (stored-row ambiguity first, then the registry's), same `kind: package` candidate shape in `packagelessAddress` order. The REST door renders through `handleRouteError` with `packageScopedCandidates`, the one renderer the plain read, the layered read and the history door use, so `details.candidates` cannot take a second shape here.
- **One difference from the plain read, inherited and declared.** The history family also refuses a package's row beside the package-less row, where the bare plain read serves the environment's item (`resolveEnvironmentWide`). That is #33193's row-slot rule (versions are numbered per name across row slots), the card's Expected names it as the rule to apply, and the changeset lists that state under BREAKING. Not a finding.
- **`?package=` selects one holder's history.** History rows are filtered by `isVersionOf`, now exported, the predicate the history door's repository read and the rollback use. The default `to` side is the addressed slot's own active row (matched on the row's binding, the package-less row for the environment's slot) and the default `from` walk runs over the filtered rows only, so neither default can reach another holder's version. A named version outside the slot, or one attributed to no package while two hold the name, is `404 VERSION_NOT_FOUND` through `versionOfAnotherSlotError`; the rollback's sentence is the same text with its outcome passed in, so that door's message is unchanged.
- **Non-holder, unknown and other-type selectors.** A package that neither holds nor ships the name is refused `409 not-held-by-qualifier` inside `historySlotOf` while some row slot holds the name; a non-slotted type is refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` on `package` before the expanded-view recursion and before any read. Both are the history door's answers because both come from the shared module. A disabled package has no arm of its own on this family; none is added or removed here.
- **Unchanged paths.** A non-slotted type returns from `historySlotOf` at once and takes the old code path. A slotted name one row slot holds, named bare, gets `addressed: false`, so no filter is applied and the single-row active read is the old one; the dogfood CONTROLs cover the one-holder name and the M1 takeover, and the facet CONTROL covers an unattributed version of a sole slot.
- **Doors.** The diff has one wire door (`GET /meta/:type/:name/diff`, scoped and unscoped registrations share the handler) and one protocol method; the runtime dispatcher has no diff branch (the route ledger row says REST-only, confirmed by grep) and no MCP or CLI caller exists. The closed query set, the repeat guard and the selector read all take `package`; `all` and the empty string name no package, as on the history door. The per-caller gate types (`app`, `book`, `doc`, `view`, `dashboard`) are disjoint from the slotted types, so no gate reads a different holder's document than the one compared. The authoring gate still runs first, so the `409` and its holder list are answered only to a caller admitted to the trail. The two SDK clients are S1.
- **Spec and generated files.** `DiffMetaItemRequestSchema` mirrors the facet's parameter type member for member and reuses `HISTORY_PACKAGE_SELECTOR_DESCRIPTION`. The five baselines, the strictness count (508 to 509), `protocol.mdx` (144 to 145 schemas, the new table) and `index.mdx` (493 to 494, 1662 to 1663) each move by exactly this one schema. The REST door reads both bounds through `.shape.fromVersion` / `.shape.toVersion`, `z.number().int().optional()`, the same reading `UNDECLARED_WHOLE_NUMBER_PARAM` gave, so no bound changes its answer.
- **Card acceptance.** Each line of Expected is met: `?package=P` diffs the addressed slot only and refuses another holder's version, the bare two-holder name is `409` naming both, the one-holder name works bare, `?package=` on another type is `400`. The Console clause is conditional and its condition is false: nothing under `ui/` calls `MetadataClient.diff()`.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` with `Metadata-protocol: added`, on the PR body and in the changeset, the pair #33193 carried. `added` is the right kind for the new request declaration: the `authorable-surface/api.json` shard gains five keys, and the level gate refuses `none` over a moved shard and refuses `added` under `no`. `@objectstack/spec` is `minor`; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/rest` are `patch` under the BREAKING banner. The claim's `no (narrowing)` was amended on the card (6898947511) before review.
- Narrowing carrier: the title carries `!`, the changeset has the **BREAKING** paragraph, the FROM / TO line with the one-line remedy, and exactly one ADR-0087 marker (`not-required (no-migration-prescription)`), which holds: no key is removed or reshaped and no stored row changes.
- CI at this head: 68 check-runs, 56 success, 10 skipped, 2 failure, none in progress. The two failures are `Test Core (7/8)` and the `Test Core` aggregate: three cases of `packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/run-date.test.ts`, each `Test timed out in 5000ms`. No scenarios file is in this diff and the cases do not reach the metadata doors. `Check Changeset`, the lint and repo gates, the type checks, `Build Docs`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` and `Spec property liveness` are green. This PASS is on the contract; the head is not green, and landing waits for a green `Test Core`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- No governed path in the file list; `sys-metadata-repository.ts` is outside the claim's first File surface and was accepted by the claim amendment.
- No ruling, maintainer line or prohibition marker is edited or removed on the touched files; one prohibition comment is added.
- No security finding. The door's caller gate, mask posture and per-caller judgment are untouched and still precede the protocol call.
- S1 names a card state the PR body gets wrong (#33310).

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix.

- **`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`** holds against its first consumer: the REST door compiles its request against the declaration and reads both bounds through it, and the protocol docblock states the three refusals the description promises.
- **`protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`** agrees with the contract it implements. The filter, the addressed active-row read and the two named-version misses are each inside the slot; the bare path is byte-for-byte the old one once `historySlotOf` answers.
- **`meta-item-history-routes.ts` / `rest-server.ts`**: the closed set, the repeat guard, the selector and the refusal rendering are the history door's, by the same helpers.

S1 (should-fix) — The published SDK cannot follow the remedy, and the PR body names a carrier that is closed. `client.meta.diffItem` (`packages/client/src/index.ts`, the client the route ledger binds to this route) sends only `from` and `to`, as does the Console client's `diff()`. After this PR an SDK caller on a two-holder name gets the `409` and has no method argument to answer it with. The Acceptance note names only the Console client and points at #33310 as where the client half belongs; #33310 lists `meta.diffItem` by name and was closed as not planned on 2026-11-15 (record 6897313072, the maintainer-directed p3 review), before this PR opened. A refusal in place of a wrong comparison is the better answer and the closure is a standing decision, so this does not block. Owed: correct the note (the SDK half is decided not planned, reopen on need, not a pending follow-up), and say in the changeset that `meta.diffItem` sends no `package`, so the FROM / TO remedy is a raw request for an SDK caller.

S2 (should-fix) — Three claims of the changeset have no pin at this door. (a) `?package=` naming a package that neither holds nor ships the name, `409 not-held-by-qualifier`: no case in the dogfood file, the facet file or the REST file. (b) The environment's slot addressed through a package (the read falls back to the package-less row, slot `null`): the new active-row match on a `null` binding is this PR's own code and no case drives it; the M1 CONTROL is bare. (c) Over HTTP the candidates are compared sorted and reduced to an id, on both the dogfood and the REST case, so neither their order nor their `kind` is pinned at the wire; only the facet pin holds the order. The rule itself is pinned on the history door by #33193, which is why this is not a must-fix.

N1 (nit) — The changeset says a package that neither holds nor ships the name is refused `409`, without the condition the protocol docblock states: only while another row slot holds the name. With no stored row of the name, such a request answers an empty comparison. The behaviour is `historySlotOf`'s (read, not in this diff); the sentence is the changeset's.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The net change is the reviewed one plus `8ed07410`.** Old merge base `68e726d6`, new merge base `b4eea885`. The PR's file list is the same 20 paths on both sides. Compared per path (the PR's own patch against each base, hunk offsets set aside): 17 paths carry the patch reviewed at `37fd6054` unchanged, and the three that differ are exactly the three files of `8ed07410` (the changeset, the facet pin, the dogfood pin). The merge `71cb83eb` differs from its main parent on those 20 paths and on no other, so it carries no hand edit outside the PR.
- **The merge of main does not touch the door's rule.** Between the two bases main moved one PR path, `protocol.ts`, in the registry write-through and heal signatures (#33979); the PR's hunk there (the `diffMetaItem` request type and docblock) is unchanged. `protocol-history-slots.ts`, `sys-metadata-repository.ts`, `meta-item-history-routes.ts`, `error-response.ts` and `packages/core` did not move, so `historySlotOf`, `isVersionOf` and the refusal renderer are the ones judged at `37fd6054`. The registry's resolver moved for `action` and `doc` only (#34073, #34036); the door asks it by call, so its bare refusal stays that read's own answer by identity.
- **No duplicate of #34036 or #34109.** #34036 judges the bare plain read of a `doc` in the registry and in `readMetaItem`; #34109 is Console only. Neither adds a package selector, a slot rule or a candidates shape to the history family, and this PR adds no judge of a `doc`. Where they meet is S2.
- **Generated files carry both sides.** Main regenerated `api-surface/contracts.json`, `authorable-surface/data.json` and `export-origins/contracts.json`, three shards this PR does not write; none of the five `api.json` shards, the strictness count, `protocol.mdx` or `index.mdx` moved on main between the bases, so each still moves by this PR's one schema and nothing was lost to a merge resolution. Main past the base (23 commits to `121017b9`) moves none of them either, and a trial merge of this head with it is clean.
- **`8ed07410` is tests and changeset prose.** No source file moves. The facet pin gains two cases and its fake host a fallback that mirrors the read `historySlotOf` asks (a package's own active row, else the package-less one), with the other cases' fixtures unaffected (they hold no package-less row). The dogfood pin gains one fixture name, two cases and wire assertions on the bare refusal. Each new assertion was checked against `historySlotOf`, `isVersionOf` and the addressed active-row read at this head: a non-holder is refused before any version is read; the environment's slot reached through a package takes the environment-attributed versions and the package-less active row, and a version of the package beside it is `404 VERSION_NOT_FOUND` saying whose.
- **One state the merge changes for a neighbouring door, inherited.** #33889 lets a bare save pick the enabled holder where an enabled and a disabled package both hold a row; the history family, this door included, still counts both row slots and refuses the bare request. That is the family's rule as #33193 set it and as the prior record noted (no arm for a disabled package), not a change of this PR.

Prior findings, by id:

- **S1 of 6902957227: changed, half closed.** The changeset now says `client.meta.diffItem` sends no `package` and that the remedy is a raw request for an SDK caller. The PR body's Acceptance note is unchanged: it still names #33310 as where the client half belongs, a card closed as not planned. Continues as S1 below, reduced to that note.
- **S2 of 6902957227: closed.** (a) The non-holder refusal is pinned at the facet (reason, candidates, no read) and over HTTP. (b) The environment's slot addressed through a package is pinned at both levels, with a fixture ordered so that a first-active-row read would pick the wrong slot. (c) The dogfood case now asserts the holders at the wire in order with their `kind`, for two packages and for a package beside the environment. The REST harness case still compares sorted ids; the wire pin exists, so nothing is owed there.
- **N1 of 6902957227: closed.** The changeset states the condition (refused while another row slot holds the name; an empty comparison with no stored row), which is what `historySlotOf` does.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged from the prior record and still right: `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` with `Metadata-protocol: added`, `minor` for `@objectstack/spec`, `patch` for `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/rest` under the BREAKING banner, one ADR-0087 marker. `8ed07410` edits two sentences of the changeset body and no level, package or marker line.
- CI at this head: 68 check-runs, 58 success, 10 skipped, none failed, none in progress. The `Test Core` failure recorded at `37fd6054` (three timed-out scenario cases outside this diff) is green here. The PR reads mergeable and clean against its base.

### ③ Boundary flags

- No governed path in the file list; the out-of-surface file (`sys-metadata-repository.ts`) is as accepted before and unchanged.
- No ruling, maintainer line or prohibition marker is edited or removed by `8ed07410` or by the merge on the PR's paths.
- No security finding. The door's caller gate, mask posture and per-caller judgment are unchanged by the delta and still precede the protocol call.
- S1 names a card state the PR body still gets wrong (#33310). S2 names a state with no card named on this PR.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix.

- **`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`** and its five baselines: unchanged since the prior record, and not made stale by the merge.
- **`protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`, `meta-item-history-routes.ts`, `rest-server.ts`**: unchanged; the code agrees with the contract as judged at `37fd6054`, and the new pins hold three more of its claims.

So at this head a bare diff of such a name is `409` with candidates, and the same request with `?package=` is that `409` again, never the `400` on `package` the changeset and the protocol docblock state for every type not stored per package: the refusal lists holders that cannot be named at this door.
